sources: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233831 (read 2026-11-06): 'This campground contains four group sites with electric hookups, and 20 family sites with electric. Additional amenities include flush toilets, drinking water, showers, a playground, beach, boat ramp and a dump station'; 'located on the shores of Fall River Lake'; phone 620-658-4445; rule maxStay 14 nights (Rolling 30 Days); no minimum-stay rule.

https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233831/rates (read 2026-11-06): Peak Season 2026-04-01..2026-10-30 (same 2027, 2028): STANDARD ELECTRIC $17, with per-site rates $18/$20/$21; STANDARD NONELECTRIC $13; group $50-$100.

https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id%3A233831&size=1000 (read 2026-11-06): 26 standard sites (001-023, 026-028) + 4 group sites (GS1-GS4). Bookable: 001-010 E30, $17 (001 RV 40 ft); 011-015, 017-020 E50 water sewer, $21; 023 E30 water, $20; 026-028 E30, $18. Not available/not reservable: 016 (E50 W S), 021 (non-electric, $13), 022 (accessible). Every standard site Back-In; longest RV 93 ft (027). Site 002 notice: 'Shoreline Site : N Distance to Shoreline : 320 Feet'.

recreation.gov official site photos (cdn.recreation.gov, 2021-09): 015, 023, 027, 028 each show the pad ending at open mown grass with the table and the lake directly beyond; 013/014 show the lake through trees.

Esri World Imagery and USGS NAIP, 2026-11-06, rec.gov site coordinates plotted: the 011-015 row ~35-50 m above the limestone shoreline on the peninsula's SE side, no road between; 023 ~35 m from the north shore, 026-028 ~40-50 m from the SW shore at the peninsula tip, each across grass/scattered trees to riprap, no road or day use between.

values.note: Electric sites $17 (001-010), $18 (026-028), $20 (023), $21 for the 50 A water/sewer row (011-015, 017-020); the $13 non-electric site 021 is not offered for booking.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233831/rates and the campsite catalog (2026-04-01..10-30 season), read 2026-11-06

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog, asset 233831: 26 standard sites (001-023, 026-028) besides 4 group sites; every standard site Driveway Entry Back-In; site 027 Max Vehicle Length 93; read 2026-11-06

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233831 ('flush toilets, drinking water, showers, a playground, beach, boat ramp and a dump station'), read 2026-11-06

note: USACE campground on a peninsula in Fall River Lake. The 011-015 full-hookup row and sites 023, 027 and 028 at the tip face the lake across open grass. --Claude
